narr: A weak cold front slowly moved through the area later on the 8th into the 9th. A wave of low pressure tracked along the front, passing through the area during that time. Plenty of moisture ahead of the boundary along with moderate instability led to areas of heavy rainfall. The slower storm motion and training storms led to areas of flooding and flash flooding.
ev: Canal Road NW was closed between Foxhall Road NW and Arizona Avenue NW due to high water.
Rock Creek Parkway northbound was closed between I-66 and K Street NW due to high water.
Flooding was reported along I-395 around the 3rd street tunnel.

The water level along Rock Creek rapidly rose above flood stage. Water covered several portions of the Valley Trail between picnic areas 7 and 10 along Rock Creek. Flooding continued until 7:30 AM EST.
lsr: A STREAM GAUGE ON ROCK CREEK NEAR SHERRILL DRIVE REACHED MINOR FLOOD STAGE.
